provenance.sourceOrg: Hayward Area Recreation and Park District
provenance.quote: On September 16th, 2024, the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District (H.A.R.D.) transitioned from at-large to by-district elections. This was due to recent legal challenges under the Federal Voting Rights Act, which prompted many municipalities, counties, and districts to shift to by-district or division elections. On May 20, 2024, the H.A.R.D. The Board of Directors adopted a resolution expressing the District’s intention to move to district-based elections.
